name: Tokatee Golf Club

scorecard_source: Third-party: GolfPass (course 1352) per-hole par, men's handicap and Black/Blue/White/Yellow yardages, read 2026-11-13; each row adds up to its printed total (Black 6,838). Black rating/slope 73.0/129 from stymie.golf (6,838 yd; GolfPass's tee table prints 72.8/125 against an older 6,806). Unverified against a printed card.
attribution: Elevation and canopy height: Oregon Department of Geology and Mineral Industries (DOGAMI) lidar
Orthophoto (checks only): Oregon Statewide Imagery Program 2024
notes: Standing defaults (COURSE_BUILD.md 4.1), 2026-11-13: the longest tee set (Black) and it is the default; all water red; OB = the OSM course boundary, roads inside it are cart paths, the driving range is OB; inland Pacific Northwest wind 1-7 mph (a sheltered Cascade valley); trees from DOGAMI lidar, trees in fairways or in the way of a centre-line drive removed and listed. Theme tokatee (new; the course chat's design).
